content.text: {"selected_round": 0, "reason": "Round 0 candidate (recipe digest duckling_tuft_crest, recipe_sha256 0ff240bb...) is host-eligible: proof accepted, single fused solid, motion passed at all 31 poses (min distance 17.2 mm, no violations), added mass only 2.06 g within the zone.
